content.short: Multi-asset wallet, remittance and crypto/fiat conversion.
content.description: BiyaPay is a global multi-asset trading wallet and payments app that lets users hold, exchange, and move both traditional and digital money in one place. From the app, people can trade cryptocurrencies such as BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, TRX, and BNB along with stablecoins like USDT, invest in US and Hong Kong stocks, and convert between more than 30 fiat currencies for cross-border remittances. BiyaPay supports depositing and withdrawing crypto over networks including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Tron, and BNB Chain, bridging on-chain assets with fiat payouts to bank accounts worldwide. Targeting globally mobile consumers, investors, and cross-border earners, BiyaPay combines a crypto exchange, brokerage, and remittance tool into a single multi-asset wallet designed for moving value across currencies, assets, and borders.
